notablePrerequisites:
Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Illuminor Szeras.
You control another nontoken creature with mana value eight or greater.
description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value eight or greater, adding at least eight {B}.
The creature dies, triggering Illuminor Szeras, untapping Illuminor Szeras.
Activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning the creature with mana value eight or greater from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
